author: Phobiaxx
body:
I feel avicus should lower its leniency...  I've seen several people who hacked before come back to hack again, after their ban, one example is: http://avicus.net/Theemeraldtroll?tab=infractions

1)I think you guys should:
a)double the ban time for each hack
b)triple the ban time
I don't think perm banning is good(aside from the big hacks), since it'll decrease the player count somewhat, and make senior mods+ jobs harder

2)also, it would be nice if you guys would release the guidelines for punishments onto the forums
Benefits:
less work for moderators
better gameplay for players

3)Also, another suggestion, would it be possible to enable NCP to block autoregen? that hack is just 2 op ;c

replies.author: RCMP_Mountie
replies.body:
I have asked a staff member and have done /help in game, and it shows that we use AntiCheat.

If they did release guidelines on the forums, this defeats the purpose of asking "If a player is doing ____, then what do you think the most appropriate punishment would be?" on the Staff Applications template on the old forums, but the questions may change in future Staff Apps, so don't judge me on this.

One hacker banned shouldn't really decrease the player amount, and if he knew he would be banned in the first place, why would he hack? A few to no hackers are regulars on Avicus, mostly just ones who found "a server" and want to hack, so therefore the player count wouldn't suffer too much. People still appeal tempbans, so the job viewing appeals as Staff is equally as hard as people who appeal with a permaban.

Just my 2 cents.

replies.author: Emmaye
replies.body: Whenever the new guidelines for punishments came out (temp banning more often for less severe hacks), the mods were told to Perm ban a hacker if they had a previous punishment for hacking, and they decided to hack again, but if it was a very small hack like NoFall, then most likely the 2nd punishment would be a longer tempban. But I haven't seen mods check to see if a hacker was previously punished for the same thing, but it must be time consuming if you did it to every hacker you have to check to see if they were punished a 2nd time xPPP
